how_to_read: Each factor is keyed by an ALIAS defined in config/variables.json -> columns. Raw PISA names live only there.
role: 'state' = an entry of the state vector (appears in both x and y, so M is square n x n); 'grouping' = only used to define groups; 'metadata' = carried along, not modelled.
The order of the 'state' entries below IS the order of the vector entries. n = number of included state factors.
category is used in Phase 4 weight analysis (NLA hypothesis): outcome, socioeconomic, regional, school, individual, attitudinal.
higher_is: whether a larger value is favourable ('better'), unfavourable ('worse') or neutral. Nothing is recoded; this only guides interpretation of signs.
encode: how a student-level value is built. aggregate: how students are combined into a group's representative vector (always with the final student weight).
missing_pct and n_valid are filled in by the preprocessing code (deliverable 0.4); leave them null here.
dimension_count is n, the number of included 'state' factors. imple.config.state_factors() computes it; set it here only as a record once factors are final.

_note: To be filled up later once the datasets are available.

_template.alias: <UPPER_SNAKE; a key of config columns, or a new name if derived>
_template.label: <human-readable name used in tables and plots>
_template.category: outcome | socioeconomic | regional | school | individual | attitudinal
_template.source_alias: <key of config columns the value is read from>
